title: Senior Fullstack developer (Python + React)
description:
Mirko Solutions is an international IT company specializing in web and mobile development for clients in the US, Canada, EU, and Australia. We deliver high-quality digital solutions including web applications, mobile apps, cloud systems, and custom software for businesses worldwide.
Due to the rapid growth of our company, we are currently looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack developer (Python + React) to join our team and work on a new international project.
Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain scalable backend and frontend functionality
- Build and improve integrations with marketplaces and third-party platforms
- Participate in API architecture improvements and service splitting
- Work with complex business logic
- Investigate and fix production and integration-related issues
- Collaborate with QA, Team Leads, and other developers during feature delivery
Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with Python and JavaScript
- Strong backend development and software architecture skills
- Experience delivering and deploying production-level projects
- Proficiency with Async IO
- Experience with React, Redux (RTK), CSS modules
- Experience with CI/CD, Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Linux, Docker, Kubernetes
- Experience integrating third-party APIs
- Experience with Data Pipelines / ETL
We offer:
- Fully remote work
- Opportunity to work on an international project
- Professional growth and development
- Friendly and supportive team environment
